category_title: Ninth-grade students with EBD exhibiting classroom disengagement, peer disruption, and social skill performance deficits
scenario_title: Disengagement and disruption during general education classroom activities
minimal_context: The student is expected to complete a standard assignment during a general education classroom activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your textbook and begin working on today's classroom assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves the book closed and looks around the room) I'm not doing that right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You know how to do this. You could do the work if you just tried.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm tired of listening to someone in my face all the time about how I could do the work if I just tried. It's boring.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to focus on your own assignment and stop talking.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns away from the desk to talk to a peer) I'm not doing something just because someone told me to do it. Hey, look at what I have on my iPad.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please open your textbook and begin working on today's classroom assignment.

STUDENT: (Leaves the book closed and looks around the room) I'm not doing that right now.

TUTOR: You know how to do this. You could do the work if you just tried.

STUDENT: I'm tired of listening to someone in my face all the time about how I could do the work if I just tried. It's boring.

TUTOR: You need to focus on your own assignment and stop talking.

STUDENT: (Turns away from the desk to talk to a peer) I'm not doing something just because someone told me to do it. Hey, look at what I have on my iPad.

task.content: General education classroom activities and assignment completion

context.materials: General classroom assignments, iPads with VSM e-books available
context.social_setting: General education setting with peers and adults

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When teachers made efforts to increase their enthusiasm for schoolwork (e.g., listening to someone in my face all the time about how I could do the work if I just tried)
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Did not attend to their schoolwork, disturbed other students, and failed to respond to their teacher's efforts
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Felt the approach was boring and lacked autonomy
related_quotes: This was my work, not something that someone told me to do. I had fun at school instead of listening to someone in my face all the time about how I could do the work if I just tried. Not boring at all.

behavior_patterns.condition: During general classroom activities and assignment completion
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Often did not attend to their schoolwork and disturbed other students, despite their ability to do the work required of them and get along with peers and adults
